model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average values of hidden state means across different layers in a neural network. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines representing different conditions: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line starts at an average value of 0.71 and remains relatively stable until around layer 20, where it begins to increase sharply, reaching an average value of 4 by layer 22. The orange dotted line starts at an average value of 0.05 and remains flat across all layers. The green solid line starts at an average value of 0.04 and also remains flat across all layers.

model_annotations.English: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average values of hidden states in a neural network model across different layers. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines representing different hidden state means: the blue dashed line indicates the hidden state mean before a gate, with an average value of 0.71; the orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after a gate, with an average value of 0.05; and the green solid line shows the hidden state mean of the baseline, with an average value of 0.04.
